name: Brian Schatz

issue_poll.name: Pew Research Center national survey of registered voters, Oct 10-16, 2022 (issues 'very important' to midterm vote)
issue_poll.note: National fallback: no 2022 Hawaii poll ranking issues was found. 'Future of democracy' merged with 'how elections and voting work'; coronavirus and the Trump/Biden investigations left out. Immigration and foreign policy tied at 54%; immigration taken.

issues.position: Lower cost of living with federal funds; no specific measure
End or reform the Senate filibuster
issues.note: No floor vote on changing the legislative filibuster this term.

issues.position: Make college more affordable; no specific measure
Protect Medicare and Medicaid; Medicare drug-price negotiation
issues.note: H.R.1 cut Medicaid spending; he opposed it.

issues.position: Cut carbon pollution, invest in clean energy; no specific measure
Ban assault weapons; universal background checks
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on either measure this term.

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices
issues.note: No floor vote on Supreme Court term limits this term.

caveats: Issue list is from national Pew polling; no ranked Hawaii issue poll from 2022 was found. Schatz and Hawaii coverage named cost of living as the state's top issue.
No debate coverage found; positions come mainly from Civil Beat and Star-Advertiser candidate questionnaires.
Votes confirmed through Hawaii Free Press weekly vote lists (S.4554, H.R.1); roll call numbers taken from the matching NH file, not checked on senate.gov.
